messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Elevated error rate and tail latency in ap-southeast inference pool (ap-southeast-2). Affects both hosted and dedicated private endpoints. P1. thread_ts=1835124300

sam_oncall: 1835124300
Pinging folks 3Paging: ap-southeast showing sustained 502/504 and long tails since ~22:04 JST. Multiple customers reporting timeouts for model streaming. Im taking lead; need a short public status blurb + localized customer notifications. Can i18n help with quick translations? @i18n-bot

rachel_sre: 1835124318
Logs show an unusual number of GRPC retries and connection resets between edge-proxy and infer cluster. Suspect a recently rolled networking kernel change on ap nodes. I'm putting the latest node build back to previous kernel on a canary host. Will post updates.

i18n-bot: 1835124335
Quick localized snippets (concise / customer-facing):
- EN: "We are investigating elevated errors and delays for inference in APAC regions. Some requests may time out or be slower than usual. Engineers are actively working on a mitigation."
- ES: "Estamos investigando un aumento de errores y demoras en la inferencia en las regiones APAC. Algunas solicitudes pueden agotar el tiempo de espera o ser ms lentas. Nuestros ingenieros estn trabajando en una soluci3n."
- PT-BR: "Estamos investigando erros e atrasos na inferncia nas regs APAC. Algumas requisi5es podem expirar ou ficar mais lentas. Engenheiros estao trabalhando na corre5o."
- KO: "APAC 지역의 추론에서 오류 및 지연 증가를 조사 중입니다. 일부 요청이 시간 초과되거나 지연될 수 있습니다. 엔지니어가 해결을 진행하고 있습니다."
- ZH-TW: "我們正在調查 APAC 區域推論服務錯誤與延遲增加的情況。部分請求可能逾時或變慢，工程師正積極處理。"

maya_support: 1835124346
I'll draft segmented emails: 1) Public status snip + link for all customers, 2) Account-targeted DM for Dedicated/Private with recommended actions (switch to regional fallback endpoint, increase timeouts). Propose send schedule so we don't wake people at night:
- APAC (affected region): immediate, but roll notifications in 5min batches to avoid alert storms (22:07 JST, 22:12 JST, 22:17 JST)
- EMEA: 23:30 CET (local evening)  quick heads-up since some EU customers route through APAC for testing
- NA: 08:30 ET (next day) for morning visibility, unless resolved before then
If resolved earlier, cancel remaining sends.

ken_engineer: 1835124360
For status page, suggest category "Partial outage - Inference (APAC)" and initial impact line: "Partial: streaming requests may time out or return errors for some customers." Keep the public blurb non-technical. Also adding: for enterprise accounts use DM and account channel.

ops-bot: 1835124368
Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/inference-network-resets  recommended steps: 1) failover edge-proxy, 2) rollback recent kernel/network module, 3) increase keepalive for GRPC, 4) monitor for tail-latency reduction.

sam_oncall: 1835124382
Posting status now. Using the i18n EN/ES/PT-BR/KO/ZH-TW snippets for email bodies. Subject line for emails: "Service notice: APAC inference errors & delays (investigating)". Maya, queue APAC immediate sends in small waves; EMEA/NA scheduled as above.

rachel_sre: 1835124410
Mitigation update: rolled back kernel on canary node, traffic to canary looks stable (fewer resets). Rolling to additional hosts in ap-southeast-2 now, will throttle to avoid mass restarts.

maya_support: 1835124425
APAC batch 1 sent at 22:07 JST (EN/ES/KO/ZH-TW/pt-BR). Support queue primed for inbound messages and escalations; included fallback tips: 1) increase client timeout by +5s, 2) use region fallback endpoint: api.fallback.apac.redwood.ai, 3) contact support if Dedicated/Private.

ken_engineer: 1835124459
If we need to programmatically schedule localized sends, use this curl call to the comms scheduler (ops token required):

```
curl -X POST "https://comms.redwood.ai/v1/schedule" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $COMMS_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"audience":"region:ap-southeast-2","send_times":["2025-03-18T22:07:00+09:00","2025-03-18T22:12:00+09:00"],"messages":{"en":"We are investigating elevated errors and delays for inference in APAC regions. Some requests may time out or be slower than usual.","es":"Estamos investigando un aumento de errores y demoras..."}}'
```

sam_oncall: 1835124487
Rollout looks promising. Please hold EMEA/NA sends until I confirm 30m stability. If we see re-regression, re-enable scheduled sends and update status page to "investigating -> partial outage".

tom_next_oncall: 1835124501
Oncall handoff: I'll take over monitoring at 23:00 JST. Sam, if you're still on, leave a short checklist: 1) confirmed rollback progress, 2) number of affected hosts, 3) current customer-facing status.

rachel_sre: 1835124538
Checklist: 1) rollback applied to 6/12 hosts, 2) GRPC resets down 70% on rolled hosts, 3) tail latency reduced from 2.3s to 0.6s on canary. I'll update timeline in the incident doc.

sam_oncall: 1835124575
Thanks team. Resolved threshold for cancelling further comms = 30m of stable healthchecks + <1% error rate rolling average. If we hit that by 23:00 JST we'll cancel EMEA/NA scheduled sends and post a recovery note instead.

---
Thread notes: chronological messages starting with incident-bot. Contains on-call coordination, localized customer snippets in EN/ES/PT-BR/KO/ZH-TW, send schedule across APAC/EMEA/NA with batching, runbook link, curl snippet for comms scheduler, mitigation rollback details, and explicit handoff instructions.
